title: Mass Reveal
subtitle: Test your grasp of Mass Reveal — EBS Flood Gates, Narrative Maintenance, 72-hour fracture timeline, Truth Packages, and Stage 3 Revelation.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Mass Reveal is the EBS-driven shattering of false reality—Narrative Maintenance into Trigger Events, Lockdown, the 72-hour fracture, Flood Gates truth, and Phase 8 tribunals. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Mass Reveal deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. When truth is absorbed and the veil thins, the sky opens: Motherships and Crystalline Arks uncloak, and the Resonating Army guides the masses from shock into resonance and home.

questions.question: What is the Mass Reveal within the Great Awakening?

options.label: A
options.text: A voluntary online poll that lets sleepers vote to keep the false reality fully intact forever, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics rather than the EBS-driven critical juncture dismantling the parasitic system without total collapse.
options.rationale: Mass Reveal broadcasts undeniable Truth Packages to break amnesia and deception—not a poll preserving false reality.

options.label: B
options.text: A permanent media festival that strengthens the parasitic overlay and never seizes global communications, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics rather than the EBS-driven critical juncture dismantling the parasitic system without total collapse.
options.rationale: The operation seizes global communications to broadcast Truth Packages that shatter the overlay—not strengthen it.

options.label: C
options.text: A random weather bulletin with no military coordination and no attempt to dismantle any parasitic system at all, disconnected from any deliberate long-game control design rather than the EBS-driven critical juncture dismantling the parasitic system without total collapse.
options.rationale: Mass Reveal is a highly coordinated EBS military and multidimensional operation—not a random weather bulletin.

options.label: D
options.text: The critical juncture executed via the EBS Operation—a coordinated military and multidimensional intervention that dismantles the parasitic system and shatters false reality without total societal collapse.
options.rationale: Mass Reveal is the critical Great Awakening juncture via EBS: multi-stage military and multidimensional intervention dismantling the parasitic system and shattering false reality without total societal collapse.

questions.hint: How it is executed and what system it systematically dismantles.

questions.question: What is the Mass Reveal Window?

options.label: A
options.text: The calculated timeframe when undeniable truths about the parasitic system and replaced elites are broadcast to purposefully fracture the collective illusion.
options.rationale: The Mass Reveal Window is the calculated timeframe for broadcasting undeniable truths about the parasitic system and replaced elites to fracture the collective illusion.

options.label: B
options.text: A private elite meeting that never reaches the public and never fractures any mass illusion instead of the calculated Mass Reveal Window fracturing the collective illusion with undeniable truths.
options.rationale: Truths are broadcast to the public to fracture the collective illusion—not kept in private elite meetings only.

options.label: C
options.text: A permanent blackout with no truth broadcast and no purposeful fracture of any collective illusion instead of the calculated Mass Reveal Window fracturing the collective illusion with undeniable truths.
options.rationale: The window is defined by truth broadcast that fractures the collective illusion—not permanent silence without disclosure.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a sports season calendar with no relation to replaced elites or parasitic-system disclosure, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.
options.rationale: The window centers parasitic-system and replaced-elite truths—not a sports calendar alone.

questions.hint: Calculated timeframe and what it is designed to fracture.

questions.question: What is the E.B.S. (Emergency Broadcast System) in this context?

options.label: A
options.text: A parasitic MSM tool that permanently blocks Whitehats from any media or internet control rather than military-controlled E.B.S. hijacking media and internet for continuous truth broadcasts.
options.rationale: Whitehats use E.B.S. to hijack media and internet for truth—not a parasitic tool blocking Whitehats forever.

options.label: B
options.text: A pure civilian streaming app that never hijacks media and never delivers continuous truth content, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is military-controlled channel override for continuous truth—not a civilian streaming app alone.

options.label: C
options.text: Nothing beyond a local weather radio with no military control and no multi-hour Truth Package cycle, and no coordinated multi-system design behind it.
options.rationale: E.B.S. delivers continuous truth broadcasts and 72+ hour Truth Packages—not local weather radio alone.

options.label: D
options.text: The military-controlled communication override Whitehats use to hijack media and internet channels for continuous truth broadcasts.
options.rationale: E.B.S. is the military-controlled override Whitehats use to hijack media and internet channels and deliver continuous truth broadcasts.

questions.hint: Who controls it and what channels it hijacks.

questions.question: Who are the Whitehats in the Mass Reveal framework?

options.label: A
options.text: Only random internet forums with no military, G.A.A., or Space Force operational role at all instead of Whitehats as allied military, G.A.A., and Space Force dismantling the 3D overlay.
options.rationale: Whitehats are operational allied military and G.A.A./Space Force forces—not symbolic forums alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Only NPC background programs that glitch and dissolve when the overlay collapses, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.
options.rationale: NPCs are soulless background programs; Whitehats are allied military and multidimensional operatives.

options.label: C
options.text: The same parasitic elites who run Draco-Grey control without any dismantling of the 3D overlay instead of Whitehats as allied military, G.A.A., and Space Force dismantling the 3D overlay.
options.rationale: Whitehats dismantle the 3D overlay; they are not the parasitic elite control structure being exposed.

options.label: D
options.text: Allied military, G.A.A. (Galactic Alliance Association), and Space Force operatives coordinating strategic dismantling of the 3D overlay.
options.rationale: Whitehats are allied military, G.A.A., and Space Force operatives coordinating strategic dismantling of the 3D overlay.

questions.hint: Allied forces named with G.A.A. and Space Force.

questions.question: What are Truth Packages during the EBS phase?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Truth Packages are concentrated multi-hour disclosure streams—not five-minute weather clips.

options.label: B
options.text: Sports highlight reels that restore parasitic narrative control without any hard-truth content rather than 72+ hour Truth Packages designed to initiate mass awakening.
options.rationale: Packages deliver evidence and disclosure for awakening—not sports reels restoring parasitic narrative.

options.label: C
options.text: Private elite archives that never air publicly and never aim to awaken the global population rather than 72+ hour Truth Packages designed to initiate mass awakening.
options.rationale: Packages are broadcast to the public for mass awakening—not sealed private archives only.

options.label: D
options.text: Concentrated streams of evidence and disclosure broadcast during EBS, spanning 72+ hours, designed to initiate mass awakening.
options.rationale: Truth Packages are concentrated evidence and disclosure streams during EBS spanning 72+ hours to initiate mass awakening.

questions.hint: Duration and awakening purpose of the broadcast streams.

questions.question: What must happen in Narrative Maintenance before the EBS takes over?

options.rationale: Before EBS, Narrative Maintenance uses clones, stand-ins, digital composites, and mimic tech to replace neutralized elites until the Mass Reveal Window.

options.label: B
options.text: Every elite is openly removed on live television with no clones, stand-ins, or mimic tech cover at all instead of Narrative Maintenance clones and mimic tech holding optics until the exact window.
options.rationale: Replacement optics maintain the illusion until the exact window—not open day-one removal without cover.

options.label: C
options.text: EBS starts first with no prior narrative cover and no need to hold public optics until a timed window instead of Narrative Maintenance clones and mimic tech holding optics until the exact window.
options.rationale: Narrative Maintenance precedes EBS takeover so the illusion holds until the calculated Mass Reveal Window.

options.label: D
options.text: Only weather forecasts continue while no royals, politicians, corporate giants, or religious leaders are optically replaced.
options.rationale: Neutralized elites include royals, politicians, corporate giants, and religious leaders replaced by optical covers.

questions.hint: Optical replacements for neutralized elites until the exact window.

questions.question: What categories of irrefutable proof do EBS disclosures systematically release?

options.text: Only sports scores and weather with no names, faces, or evidence of elite crimes at all.
options.rationale: Disclosures systematically shatter the 3D illusion with hard crime evidence—not sports and weather alone.

options.label: D
options.text: Only anonymous rumors without election fraud, trafficking, harvesting, or cult ritual proof.
options.rationale: Broadcasts give irrefutable proof with names, faces, and evidence across those crime categories.

questions.hint: Fraud, trafficking, harvesting, and cult crimes with names and faces.

options.rationale: Bloodline Exposure Evidence proves royals, popes, and presidents were controlled by non-human Draco-Grey influence rather than operating independently.

options.label: C

options.rationale: Bloodline Exposure specifically names royal families, popes, and presidents under non-human control.

options.text: That every royal, pope, and president always operated in pure independence with zero non-human influence.

questions.question: What does Medical and Vaccine Truth release show, and what dual outcome follows?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Medical and Vaccine Truth shows deliberate depopulation via toxic injections, driving mass outrage and simultaneous mass awakening.

questions.hint: Depopulation plans and simultaneous public response.

questions.question: What is Phase 5: Trigger Events designed to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Start full EBS hard truths on hour zero with no sirens, no supply disruptions, and no staged edge of questioning instead of Phase 5 Trigger Events pushing questioning without full panic.
options.rationale: Trigger Events precede lockdown and EBS; they stage edge-of-questioning conditions before full flood-gate truths.

options.label: B
options.text: Cancel all geopolitical tension so the public never questions anything and never begins awakening instead of Phase 5 Trigger Events pushing questioning without full panic.
options.rationale: Trigger Events push the public to the edge of questioning everything—not cancel tension into permanent sleep.

options.label: C
options.text: Nothing beyond open mothership skies first so masses interpret contact as invasion with no prior conditioning, and no coordinated multi-system design behind it.
options.rationale: Scare events come before EBS conditioning; sky opening before EBS would collapse masses into invasion fear.

options.label: D
options.text: Deploy geopolitical tensions, air raid sirens, and staged supply disruptions to push the public to question everything without inciting full panic.
options.rationale: Phase 5 Trigger Events use geopolitical tensions, air raid sirens, and staged supply disruptions to start awakening questioning without full panic.

questions.hint: Geopolitical tools that push questioning without full panic.

questions.question: What happens in Phase 6: The Lockdown Window?

options.label: A
options.text: Only sports stadiums close while police remain fully in charge and internet never goes dark, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point rather than Phase 6 visible military and global communications blackout for controlled truth.
options.rationale: Military replaces world police visibility and main internet cables are severed—not sports-only limited lockdown.

options.label: B
options.text: All military vanishes and every cable stays online so parasitic media can spin every truth claim freely, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics rather than Phase 6 visible military and global communications blackout for controlled truth.
options.rationale: Military becomes visible and cables are severed to control the environment—not vanish with open parasitic spin.

options.label: C
options.text: EBS hard bloodline truths air first with no street military and no communications blackout cover, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics rather than Phase 6 visible military and global communications blackout for controlled truth.
options.rationale: Lockdown and blackout create the controlled environment before and around the EBS flood-gate sequence.

options.label: D
options.text: Military becomes visible in the streets to maintain order, replacing the world police, while a global communications blackout severs main internet cables for a controlled truth-broadcast environment.
options.rationale: Phase 6 places visible military for order, replacing world police, and creates global communications blackout by severing main cables for controlled truth broadcast.

questions.hint: Visible military role and communications environment for truth.

questions.question: What defines The Cut (Hour 0–12) in the 72-Hour Fracture Timeline?

options.label: A
options.text: Internet stays fully online with calm MSM and zero panic-blame narratives toward any geopolitical actor instead of The Cut darkening communications with panic-blame toward Russia, China, and Iran.
options.rationale: The Cut darkens communications and floods channels with panic-blame—not calm full-online MSM.

options.label: B
options.text: Only soft EBS reassurance airs with “STAY CALM YOU ARE SAFE” and no dark cables at all, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Soft reassurance is Phase 7 EBS sequence content; The Cut is cable dark and panic-blame flooding.

options.label: C
options.text: Internet and communications go dark while mainstream channels flood with panic and blame narratives aimed at Russia, China, and Iran.
options.rationale: The Cut (0–12) darkens internet and communications and floods mainstream channels with panic and blame toward Russia, China, and Iran.

options.label: D
options.text: Motherships uncloak immediately with no false-flag wobble stage and no cable blackout first, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Sky opening comes after EBS conditioning; The Cut is early blackout panic-blame, not immediate uncloaking.

questions.hint: Communications status and blame narratives on mainstream channels.

questions.question: What defines The Wave (Hour 12–36)?

options.label: B
options.text: Crowd surges hit supermarkets and fuel stations while NPC programming severely glitches.
options.rationale: The Wave (12–36) brings supermarket and fuel-station surges and severe NPC glitching with aggression or dazed shutdown.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Truth Tribunals finish every confession with no crowd surges and no NPC glitch signs at all.
options.rationale: Tribunals belong to Phase 8 aftermath; The Wave is survival surges and NPC glitching in the fracture timeline.

questions.hint: Crowd locations and how NPC programming behaves.

questions.question: What defines Opening Hour (Hour 36–72)?

options.rationale: Sky opening is Stage 3 after truth is absorbed; Opening Hour is false-flag fall and fracture signs first.

options.label: B
options.text: False flag narratives wobble and fall; truth leaks with a physical Frequency Fracture.

options.rationale: Opening Hour is truth leak and physical fracture signs; hard truths continue in the EBS flood-gate sequence.

options.label: D
options.text: False flags become permanently unchallengeable while electronics never flicker and no Frequency Fracture is felt.
options.rationale: False flags fall and environmental fracture signs appear—not permanent false flags without glitch.

questions.question: What is Phase 7: EBS — The Flood Gates?

options.label: B

options.label: D
options.text: The military takes total control of the airwaves for a 72+ hour broadcast cycle with a calibrated soft-to-hard truth sequence.
options.rationale: Phase 7 Flood Gates: military takes total airwave control for a 72+ hour calibrated broadcast cycle.

questions.question: What is the Immediate Reassurance message at the start of the EBS sequence?

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.rationale: EBS begins continuous calibrated broadcast—not 72 hours of silence without soft truths.

options.label: D
options.text: Soft truths first to avoid immediate trauma, with the message: “STAY CALM YOU ARE SAFE, MILITARY CONTROL ACTIVE TO PROTECT YOU”.
options.rationale: Immediate Reassurance presents soft truths first; the initial message is stay calm, you are safe, military control active to protect you.

options.rationale: The operation requires a precise order—not unstructured simultaneous chaos without sequence.

options.text: EBS hard truths alone with no scare events, no communications cut, and no lockdown environment.
options.rationale: Without preceding WW3 Scare or BlueBeam illusions, sleepers would ignore broadcasts; order includes scare and cut.

questions.hint: Scare, cut, EBS, lockdowns, then revelation sequence.

options.label: B
options.text: If the sky opened before EBS conditioning, the masses would interpret it as an alien invasion and collapse into fear.
options.rationale: If the sky opened before EBS conditioned the public, masses would read it as alien invasion and collapse into fear.

options.label: C
options.text: Because sky opening first always creates instant calm resonance with zero fear and zero misinterpretation.
options.rationale: Without EBS conditioning first, sky opening triggers invasion fear collapse—not instant calm resonance.

options.label: D
options.text: Because EBS is optional and sky opening alone is always enough for sleepers to accept truth calmly.

questions.question: What does Phase 8: Aftermath and Stabilization bring after false reality is shattered?
